name: Distilled Venom
description: A flask that went in as poison and came out as twice the poison: the fluid is the midden green every venom on this shelf is drawn in, and settled at the bottom of the bulb are three lumps of the concentrate — what the boiling left behind, and the only part of the picture that is brighter than the liquid holding it. The find doubles what a poison does rather than adding a poison of its own, so it is drawn as a *quantity* of the same substance, not as a new one: same green as the claw and the acid, more of it, and heavier. This is the first thing in the game to compose `ss.lib.vial`, which was drawn for a roster of draughts the game decided against; a recipe is the one find that is honestly a thing in a flask, so the flask finally has a use. Stopper and glass highlight come from `ss.lib.vial-cap` last, over the sediment, which is the order that library pair exists to enforce.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
